title: Financial Assistance Policy, Section 12 — Revocation of an Award
content:
**12.1** Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), an approved award is revoked only on one of the revocation grounds documented in the case: information the patient supplied is shown to be false, or a third-party liability payment (auto, premises or workers' compensation settlement) for the covered services was received and not disclosed.

**12.2** On revocation every charity adjustment booked under the award is reversed, each against the award application it undoes, restoring the patient's liability on that encounter.

**12.3** A reversal is booked once per award application.

**12.4** Revocation for any other reason, such as a later rise in income during the award period, is not permitted; the award runs to its end date.

| Circumstance documented in the case | Revocation |
|---|---|
| information the patient supplied shown to be false | permitted |
| undisclosed third-party liability settlement for the covered services | permitted |
| the household's income rises during the award period | not permitted — the award runs to its end date |
